{"14": {"v": "reject", "score": 1, "why": "This is a downscaled copy of the top-down map, not a side or eye-level battle view."},
"67": {"v": "reject", "score": 1.5, "why": "The perspective is broken: a flat green band fills the top, the stone pillars float over the treetops, and the lower half is busy canopy foliage with a blue stream instead of standable ground."},
"34": {"v": "pass", "score": 4, "why": "This eye-level night forest edge has the two stone pillars and calm dark grass, but the ground rises into a slope on the right, so the floor is not fully flat."},
"77": {"v": "pass", "score": 4.5, "why": "This crisp night view of the forest entrance shows the two pillars with teal panels matching the map, and the lower half is clean, flat, dark grass."},
"72": {"v": "reject", "score": 1, "why": "This is a daytime desert with cacti and mesas, which does not match the night forest entrance on the map."},
"24": {"v": "pass", "score": 4.5, "why": "This eye-level night forest gateway has a glimpse of dark sky, two stone pillars flanking the path, and a flat, calm grass floor across the lower half, in a limited pixel palette."}}
message.reasoning:
The first image is the map, with labels 14, 67, 34, 77, 72, 24 matching images 2-7. Image 2 is just a downscaled copy of the map, so I'm rejecting that. Image 3 shows a green sky with dense tree canopy covering the lower half and floating stone pillars over a blue river, but the foliage pattern doesn't read as floor, so I'm giving it a low score around 1.5. Now I'm moving on to look at image 4.

Image 4 shows a side view forest scene at night with two stone pillars and flat grass covering most of the lower portion, so I'd rate it around 4. Image 5 has pillars with glowing cyan panels that echo the teal markings on the map, with flat ground below, earning a 4.5. Image 6 is a daytime desert scene, clearly wrong, so that's a reject at 1. Image 7 shows a forest at night with stone lanterns bearing markings and flat grass, also around 4.5.
